module.name: 5Guides
module.title: 5Guides — Awareness, Alignment, Coherence, Clarity, Continuity
module.author: Nawder Loswin (pen name)
module.description: Machine-oriented representation of the 5Guides student-learning pathway through Awareness, Alignment, Coherence, Clarity, and Continuity.
module.purpose: Expose the structure, learning sequence, assessment boundaries, provenance, optional AI role, formal companions, and independent-application destination of 5Guides in a compact AI-readable form.

sequence.name: Clarity
sequence.question: Can this be understood and inspected?

ai_edition_model.purpose: Represent human-facing learning materials as explicit structured objects rather than reproduce Markdown formatting.
ai_edition_model.transformation_rule: Preserve educational meaning, uncertainty, provenance, formalization boundaries, and mastery criteria while exposing structure for AI consumption.

guide_compaction.rule: Combine each four-file human Guide into one structured Guide object.

avoid: empirical-validation claims derived only from formal verification

notes.identity_fields: id, name, order, core_question, student_artifact, badge, previous_guide, and next_guide live under identity, not at the Guide root. previous_guide and next_guide are file links. The opening Guide (Awareness) uses previous_guide: null. The terminal Guide (Continuity) uses next_guide: null and identity.destination: "Independent Application". Do not store the post-sequence destination in next or next_guide.
notes.purpose: The Guide-level purpose object uses primary, learning_goal, and principle. Guides use singular learning_goal rather than learning_objectives. On Alignment, a separate comparison_purpose object records the purpose of a given comparison (question, principle, example) and must not reuse the top-level purpose key.
notes.retry: Awareness, Alignment, Coherence, and Clarity have a top-level retry object. Continuity currently records retryability only as assessment.mastery.retryable and has no top-level retry section. Do not invent Continuity retry guidance solely to satisfy required_sections.
notes.provenance: The provenance section is artifact-lineage metadata across the set. Continuity also has a conceptual provenance_as_continuity section (relationship, continuity_question, principle). Those keys must remain distinct.
notes.related_navigation: related uses the same previous_guide / next_guide file-link shape as identity, including next_guide: null on Continuity.

explore.topics_and_activities: Both keys are present. A Guide may have content in one list and an empty array in the other. Do not invent educational items to fill an empty list.
explore.learning_mode: Optional. Use only when a pedagogical mode is already stated. Coherence previously used learning_style for the same idea Continuity recorded as learning_mode (ordinary examples before formal abstraction). The common key is learning_mode; treat learning_style as a retired alias of learning_mode, not a second concept.
explore.primary_habit: Optional. Include when already stated; do not invent a habit.
explore.additional_fields_allowed: Uniquely meaningful fields may be retained, such as Continuity explore.ai_role.

student_record.judgment_states: Always placed inside student_record. Use an empty array when a Guide has no controlled judgment vocabulary. When states are structured objects with meanings, preserve that structure; do not flatten them to labels.

awareness_check.purpose: Identify what the learner noticed after first exposure and what may deserve another look.

mastery_checkpoint.purpose: Demonstrate practical use of the Guide skill on a fresh problem.

principles: Assess the structural skill rather than vocabulary recall.
Preserve uncertainty when evidence is insufficient.
Use retry as part of learning.
Do not require optional feedback for mastery.

badge_contract.meaning: Completed the relevant learning journey and demonstrated its defined skill.

ai_companion_contract.principle: AI can accompany the reasoning. The learner still owns the journey.

privacy_contract.principle: Learning does not grant us permission to observe the learner.

formalization_contract.formal_verification_question: Given these definitions and assumptions, does the conclusion follow?
formalization_contract.modeling_question: Do these definitions and assumptions represent what we intended to describe?
recommended_prompts: What did the formal model define?
What would be required to go further?

lean_contract.validation_boundary: Compiler acceptance verifies the formal artifacts under the stated Lean environment. It does not establish empirical validity of the broader source frameworks.

origin_contract.boundary: Project lineage represents development and interpretation, not a strict proof chain and not a claim that earlier materials originally contained the Five Guides in their present form.
principles: Preserve source language separately from later interpretation.
Do not infer historical influence from structural similarity alone.
Preserve revisions, abandoned relationships, and unresolved gaps when relevant.
Allow AACCC to inspect its own project lineage.
